items.title: Canada says it will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down
items.description: A new 50% levy on $20bn of Canadian imports comes into force after a last-minute breakdown in trade talks.

items.title: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
items.description: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

items.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
items.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

items.title: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' strike
items.description: Nine people are still missing after the attack which left 130 injured, including a number of children.

items.title: One killed in sword attack at Swedish school
items.description: Officials say another three people were injured, and an 18-year-old male suspect shot and arrested.

items.title: Father leaves 7-year-old son alone on Mount Fuji to continue hike, reports say
items.description: The man had taken his two boys on the trip but is said to have left one behind when he got tired.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy suffering 'command hallucination' when she killed children, court hears
items.description: The defence brought their final witness - a forensic psychiatrist - to the stand to testify about the effects of postpartum psychosis.
